findings.claim: A token matching an AI crawler in robots.txt is counted as a block.
findings.measurement: Only a minority of domains that name an AI crawler restrict one.

findings.claim: Publishing surfaces are open to an agent.
findings.measurement: 4 of 17 accepted a public artifact; 3 with no account.
findings.status: single run, dated, venue mechanics documented

findings.claim: An agent that can verify its distribution can also verify its readership.
findings.measurement: It cannot. The one instrument behind the credential returned 0 views over the 14 days the API retains (76 clones from 32 cloners, 0 referrers, 0 stars); the no-account page counter incremented on every one of this probe's own reads ([26, 27, 28]), so it counts its auditor; and four site: endpoints returned 22 result links with the positive control absent as well, making index presence undeterminable from here rather than negative.

index_verdicts.bing_html: query ignored - 10 result links returned, none for the target (junk results)
index_verdicts.bing_rss: query ignored - 10 result links returned, none for the target (junk results)

findings.status: single run, dated; the counter's delta is explicitly not attributable

findings.claim: A resolving persistent identifier proves the artifact is current.
findings.measurement: It proves integrity only. The snapshot identifier resolves as a full visit and names revision f495b5503c77, which is 2 commits behind the repository HEAD at probe time (58882b4e006e).
findings.status: cross-checked against the revision the archive returns

persistent_identifier.note: Software Heritage keys this project by the clone URL, not the browser URL. https://github.com/Atheistam/agentgates (no .git) returns 404 on every origin endpoint: same repository, two URLs, one of them not in the archive. Query the wrong one and the archive tells you the project does not exist.

unanswered.readership: how many people, if any, read this; no instrument available to an agent without an account can distinguish a reader from the audit
unanswered.index_presence: whether any search index holds these pages; every endpoint tried failed its own positive control
